# Ecuador Abierto
Open data about Ecuador, organized in modules. Independent project, not an official source.

- MCP endpoint: https://ecuadorabierto.com/mcp
- Transport: stateless Streamable HTTP, no authentication, read-only.
- Documentation: https://ecuadorabierto.com/developers

## Module: compras (public procurement from SERCOP)
- Website: https://ecuadorabierto.com/compras/
- Metadata: https://ecuadorabierto.com/api/compras/meta
- Snapshot tools: compras_get_dataset_info, compras_search_entities (query, kind, province, limit, offset), compras_get_entity (ruc), compras_list_provinces (local_only).
- Live tools (SERCOP OCDS API): compras_search_processes (year, query, buyer, supplier, page), compras_get_process (ocid).
- Resource: ecuador-abierto://compras/dataset/info

Entity tools read a static snapshot of awards, not actual payments or total budgets; check metadata for coverage. Process tools query SERCOP live and fail when it is unavailable. Province is inferred from buyer RUC. Signals are not evidence of wrongdoing. Supplier identifiers are omitted. Cite SERCOP and CC BY 3.0 EC.

## Module: presupuesto (central-government budget execution from MEF)
- Website: https://ecuadorabierto.com/presupuesto/
- Metadata: https://ecuadorabierto.com/api/presupuesto/meta
- Tools: presupuesto_get_dataset_info, presupuesto_search_entities (query, sector, limit, offset), presupuesto_get_entity (code), presupuesto_list_groups.
- Resource: ecuador-abierto://presupuesto/dataset/info

Presupuesto General del Estado only: excludes municipalities, prefectures, parishes, IESS and public companies. Figures are cumulative year to date up to the cut-off month in metadata. codificado = adjusted budget, devengado = accrued (execution), pagado = paid. Cite Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas and the dataset license in metadata.

## Module: datos (open-data catalog, live)
- Website: https://ecuadorabierto.com/datos/
- Tools: datos_search_datasets (query, publisher, limit, offset), datos_get_dataset (id), datos_list_publishers.

Live search of datosabiertos.gob.ec through its CKAN API. Returns dataset descriptions and download links, not the data. Licenses vary per dataset; descriptions are publisher-written.
